english_scenario: Two HTTP 200 responses use the same URL and filename, but payload bytes differ.
english_expected_property: Keep distinct SHA-256 values and acquisition timestamps; identify a new byte revision without asserting the publisher corrected the economics.

english_scenario: Two names or URLs deliver byte-identical payloads.
english_expected_property: Keep the same byte identity and two locator observations; no invented content revision.

english_scenario: An ETag is unchanged even though observed payload bytes change.
english_expected_property: The observed content SHA takes precedence for byte identity; retain the validator discrepancy as diagnostic evidence.

english_scenario: A server returns 304 Not Modified when the previous payload is absent.
english_expected_property: Mark the input unavailable; a conditional HTTP response alone is not a successful data acquisition.

english_scenario: An HTTP 200 returns HTML instead of the expected XLSX.
english_expected_property: Fail domain/format validation and keep a typed receipt; do not interpret HTML as an empty statistical sheet.

english_scenario: A digest/manifest survives but a prior source file was removed.
english_expected_property: Report replay unavailable; do not silently substitute bytes from the current URL.

english_scenario: The input file is rewritten between stat and actual parsing.
english_expected_property: Detect non-consistent input or hash the actual data bytes read; never join an old file stat to newly read content.

english_scenario: A revised classification data file is paired with an older structure file.
english_expected_property: Reject or qualify the incompatible bundle; do not silently select unrelated files by latest local mtime.

english_scenario: One input digest is used with two core revisions or calculation-method references.
english_expected_property: Preserve separate run/method lineage; different results do not imply a source-byte revision.

english_scenario: A process crashes after writing staging bytes but before accepted publication.
english_expected_property: Do not display the output as a completed artifact; preserve the source receipt only if it was actually committed.

english_scenario: The domain core is invoked from Jupyter without a desktop application.
english_expected_property: Return in-memory provenance and allow explicit portable JSON export; no GUI or platform dependency is required for subject provenance.

english_scenario: Different chats request source inputs at nearly the same observed time.
english_expected_property: Assign distinct Run identities and source references; an acquisition timestamp is not a globally unique primary key.

english_scenario: An input URL or request header contains a token.
english_expected_property: Redact shared receipts and preserve restricted diagnostics separately; never serialize the secret into a public Artifact.

english_scenario: A SORS calculation is repeated with identical source bytes but a changed assumption/evidence tier.
english_expected_property: Keep domain epistemic qualification independent from source-byte digest and computation replay status.

english_scenario: Two workbook packages encode equivalent table numbers using different bytes.
english_expected_property: Keep distinct raw hashes; assert semantic equivalence only after a declared typed comparison.

english_scenario: Two client devices disagree on clock or time-zone settings.
english_expected_property: Record acquisition time in an explicit UTC convention and disclose the actual clock uncertainty/authority.

english_scenario: Remote storage commits a write, but the acknowledgment is lost.
english_expected_property: Record OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and reconcile before retrying; do not falsely assert RETAINED or safely absent data.

english_scenario: A package rebuild keeps a version string while bundled registry bytes differ.
english_expected_property: Compare actual build identity or a bundled registry manifest digest; package version alone is insufficient.
